summary.zh: 本日关注两种提高预测可信度的思路：以谱图证据重排从头测序候选，以及用严格的数据划分检验保留时间模型。
summary.en: Today's papers examine spectral evidence for de novo candidate reranking and stricter validation of retention-time prediction.

zh: 本日关注两种提高预测可信度的思路：以谱图证据重排从头测序候选，以及用严格的数据划分检验保留时间模型。
最值得深入的是把模型输出与可验证证据连接起来，并让评测划分真正对应新肽、新骨架或新实验条件。
本次核查覆盖可访问的主要期刊目录及出版社索引；部分 ACS、MCP 与 Nature 页面访问受限，不能视为完整覆盖。
en: Today's papers examine spectral evidence for de novo candidate reranking and stricter validation of retention-time prediction.
The key direction is connecting model outputs to verifiable evidence and matching evaluation splits to the intended deployment setting.
This selection draws on accessible journal listings and publisher-indexed records; access restrictions prevented complete coverage of some ACS, MCP and Nature pages.

papers.title: ScopeNovo: a De Novo Peptide Sequencing Method Using Spectrum-Spectrum Similarity to Refine the Prediction Accuracy

read_scope.en: Publisher abstract and repository README; manuscript, supplementary analyses and code execution not checked
read_scope.zh: 已读出版社摘要及仓库 README；未核验稿件全文、补充分析或运行代码

commentary.zh: ScopeNovo 对 π-PrimeNovo 生成的候选肽进行谱图相似度重排序：优先匹配参考谱库，缺失时使用 Prosit 预测谱，避免只依赖解码分数。作者在九物种基准的两套数据上报告，注释充分设定下准确率为 0.711/0.737，RankNovo 为 0.687/0.682。值得借鉴的是将候选生成与谱图证据验证分开；收益依赖参考谱可得性，仍需检查谱库与测试集隔离及错误率校准，不能把准确率提升等同于 FDR 受控。
commentary.en: ScopeNovo reranks π-PrimeNovo candidates using spectral similarity, prioritizing library spectra and falling back to Prosit predictions. In the well-annotated setting, the authors report peptide accuracies of 0.711/0.737 on two nine-species benchmarks, versus 0.687/0.682 for RankNovo. Separating candidate generation from spectral verification is useful, but library availability, library–test separation and error calibration need scrutiny; accuracy gains do not establish FDR control.

papers.title: Hybrid Graph Neural Network Ensemble with Stacked Meta-Learning for Laboratory-Conditioned Chromatographic Retention-Time Prediction
papers.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B

publication_status.en: Peer-reviewed article, online ahead of issue
publication_status.zh: 同行评审论文，在线先行发表

read_scope.zh: 已核验出版社索引中的摘要、作者及补充材料说明；未读全文和补充分析

commentary.zh: 该方法结合 GAT、GCN、分子指纹网络与 ExtraTrees，并显式学习实验室条件，用于小分子保留时间预测。作者在 23 家实验室的 3,776 条观测上报告，按分子身份分组验证的 MAE 为 0.360 分钟，按骨架划分则为 0.670 分钟，清楚展示了评测难度对结果的影响。最值得借鉴的是防止同一分子跨训练测试泄漏并单独检验集成增益；结果限于已覆盖实验室标签，不能解释为对新实验室的泛化。
commentary.en: This retention-time model combines GAT, GCN and fingerprint networks with ExtraTrees and learned laboratory embeddings. Across 3,776 observations from 23 laboratories, the authors report MAE values of 0.360 minutes under molecular-identity grouping and 0.670 minutes under scaffold-aware validation. Identity-safe splits and explicit ensemble comparisons are particularly useful, but the demonstrated scope is new chemical groups within represented laboratory labels, not generalization to unseen laboratories.
